title: Listening Drill — Community canteen shift — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Community canteen shift — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on community canteen shift last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with long queues. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: missing tray.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of portion size so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow hair net instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the shift leader before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
